digest.component_or_area: Plan-review coaching system (overlay criterion and corrective move)
propositions: A project-only criterion `project.symbol-reference-completeness` with advisory posture must be added to route to plan_review only, because code-review's closed `applies_when` vocabulary cannot fire project.* criterion ids
The criterion detects plans whose affected-file or call-site inventory was enumerated by hand or incompletely rather than derived from the symbol graph
An accompanying coaching move must direct re-derivation using `find_referencing_symbols` and string-literal sweeps (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) that LSP cannot resolve
Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven via `code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry` reading `.rebar/code_review_moves.json`, so no engine wiring is required

The criterion fires deterministically on incomplete inventories at validity 1.0 and correctly abstains on complete inventories, though move selection is controlled by LLM coach rather than configuration
